instruction: Add fox@someuniversity.edu to the receiver field of the email draft.

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent opened tuition_payment.xlsx, misread 2 of 4 unpaid students (typed john and sophia instead of iron and stella), added emails to To field, then spent remaining turns stuck on network save dialog.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can open files from file manager, read spreadsheet data, switch between windows, type email addresses into Thunderbird compose To field, interact with Thunderbird dialogs.
metadata.failure_analysis: Model hallucinated spreadsheet data - correctly identified fox and nancy as unpaid but incorrectly added john and sophia (who had 'Yes') instead of iron and stella. Then wasted ~20 turns waiting for stuck network save.
metadata.task_rationale: Simplified to adding a single known email address directly, removing the spreadsheet reading step that caused the original failure. Tests basic Thunderbird compose To field interaction.
metadata.explanation: Task requires adding a single email address to the Thunderbird compose To field. Evaluator checks accessibility tree for the address pill containing fox@someuniversity.edu.

scoring_breakdown.add_fox_email: 1.0 - fox@someuniversity.edu appears as address pill in To field

llm_judge_reasons: Getter (get_accessibility_tree) correctly extracts the Thunderbird UI state as XML accessibility tree
Metric (check_accessibility_tree) correctly parses XML and applies CSS selector to find matching elements
CSS selector accurately targets the To field address pill containing fox@someuniversity.edu using substring match (name*=)
Complete coverage: the single instruction requirement (add email to To field) is fully verified by the evaluator
Data flow is correct: get_rule returns the rules list, check_accessibility_tree receives it as the rules parameter
Postconfig (10s sleep) is reasonable to allow UI to settle before reading accessibility tree
